name: Eternal Dawn
source:
The Nox begins where the broken creatures lie in wait, looking to tear down the borders that keep Humans and Vampires apart. Ember University trains Keepers to protect borders and boundaries to help keep the secret alive.

[From [url=https://rooftopsrevolution.itch.io/eternal-dawn]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
诺克斯从破碎生物潜伏之处开始，试图拆毁人类与吸血鬼之间的边界。余烬大学训练守门人保护边界，让秘密延续。

[来源：[url=https://rooftopsrevolution.itch.io/eternal-dawn]itch.io[/url]]
